Container.Name: yt-fifo
Container.Overview:
Queue YouTube videos and stream their audio into Snapcast as raw PCM. HTTP API and a one-page web UI for queueing, skipping, pausing and seeking.
This standalone container writes to a named pipe (or a snapserver tcp:// source). If you run the home-audio container you do not need it: yt-fifo is built into that image and launched by snapserver directly, with track metadata and play/pause/next wired into Snapweb and Home Assistant.

Config.Name: API port
Config.Description: HTTP API and web UI. POST {"url": ...} to /queue.

Config.Name: Pipe directory
Config.Description: Host directory shared with snapserver; the FIFO is created inside it. Must be the same host path snapserver's pipe:// source reads from (home-audio mounts it as /fifos).

Config.Name: Output
Config.Description: Where PCM goes: a FIFO path under /pipe, or tcp://host:port for a snapserver tcp:// source in server mode.

Config.Name: Sample rate
Config.Description: Must match the sampleformat of the snapserver source.

Config.Name: Channels
Config.Description: Must match the sampleformat of the snapserver source.

Config.Name: Volume
Config.Description: Initial output volume 0..1 (software gain, before the snapclients' own volume). Adjustable at runtime from the web UI, POST /volume or Home Assistant.

Config.Name: Max volume (scaling)
Config.Description: Fixed scaling 0..1 on top of the volume: what volume 1.0 amounts to. Lower it when YouTube is much louder than the other snapserver sources.

Config.Name: Dither (LSB)
Config.Description: Triangular dither added after the volume scaling, 0 disables. Keeps quiet passages from being exact zeros, which makes DACs like the PCM5102A mute and click; use 16 if a snapclient applies a low soft volume on top.

Config.Name: Extra yt-dlp arguments
Config.Description: Appended to every yt-dlp call, e.g. --cookies /pipe/cookies.txt for age-restricted videos.
